plannedAudioInserts.script: Brew & Brews Radio, Louisburg, Kansas. Broadcasting from the coffee roastery after dark.
Fresh roasted right here in Louisburg. Brew & Brews Coffee Roastery. Brew Something Bold.
I was going to give you a proper howl... [clears throat] woof. Right. Back to the show.
Fog is settling low over town. The goblins are heading home, the beasts are moving downwind, and the streets are getting quiet.
That brings tonight's broadcast to a close from Brew & Brews Radio. Keep the porch light on, keep the coffee warm, and we'll find you again after dark.
